what_it_does: Describes HPIM-NoC, a simulation and optimization framework for networks-on-chip (interconnects connecting multiple processor cores) where some processors are processing-in-memory (PIM) cores with different computational capabilities mixed together. Standard network-on-chip simulators assume all cores are identical; this framework models heterogeneous cores with varied capabilities, including realistic simulation of communication delays through the network and internal processing pipeline stages. Includes an automated architecture search using simulated annealing (iterative optimization algorithm) to find good configurations of mixed core types.
